analysis_role: post-hoc exploratory supplement; does not replace the primary 14-method results

target_batch.cross_task: three unlabeled target recordings per direction
target_batch.inference_type: transductive target-batch, not single-recording online inference

gain_response.metric: ordinary recording accuracy difference between fused and neural branches
gain_response.aggregation: within each seed, geometric recording aggregation followed by gain; median of five seed-specific gains
gain_response.evaluation_limit: fixed gain-target gates are evaluated on participant-macro balanced accuracy and are not described as directly optimizing it

methods.double_exclusion_dasf: all fitting and selection exclude outer target participant T and meta-validation participant M
methods.double_exclusion_cbsf: all fitting and selection exclude outer target participant T and meta-validation participant M
methods.target_task_gain_cbsf: cross-task held-out target-task response; both directions of the current participant are excluded from gate fitting

statistics.sensitivity_test: two-sided Wilcoxon Pratt normal approximation without continuity correction
statistics.bootstrap: 10,000 participant-cluster percentile draws, conditional on saved fitted predictions
